meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 当 Codex 成功完成补丁、写入、编辑等操作后,插件会注册 PostToolUse 钩子;若 comment-checker 报出警告,Codex 会收到阻断性反馈,需先修复或解释被标记的注释再继续。
howto.when: 在 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类调用成功之后触发;非编辑类工具会被忽略。

say.text: comment-checker 报了警告,帮我看看那条注释并修掉
say.note: Codex 会先处理被标记的注释

say.text: 解释一下为什么这条注释被标记,然后再继续
say.note: 先给原因,再接着原任务

say.text: 把刚触发警告的那行注释改写清楚,再继续改动
say.note: 改写注释后回到原操作

howto.what_en: It registers a PostToolUse hook after successful apply_patch, write, edit, and similar calls. If comment-checker reports a warning, Codex gets blocking feedback and must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: It activates after a successful edit-like tool call such as apply_patch, write, or edit. Non-edit tools are ignored.

say_en.text: comment-checker warned about a comment - fix that comment for me
say_en.note: Codex handles the flagged comment first

say_en.text: Explain why this comment was flagged, then keep going
say_en.note: Gives the reason, then resumes the task

say_en.text: Rewrite the flagged comment clearly, then continue the change
say_en.note: Returns to the original edit after rewriting
